about.title: About Me
about.tags: FRONT-END DEVELOPER • NUXT SPECIALIST • AI INTEGRATOR
about.p1: I'm Alfin Almustajab, a Front-End Developer based in Indonesia. I focus on building modern, responsive web interfaces with Nuxt.js, managing and connecting data efficiently via Supabase, and enriching it all with AI integrations to create meaningful digital products.
about.p2: I'm passionate about crafting applications that not only work well but also deliver a comfortable, intuitive UI/UX experience for users. Right now, I keep exploring the latest web technologies to bring innovative solutions to life.
